evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.6 ppm early in growth.
Oxygen rose to 18.7 ppm under unchanged growth setpoints.
Oxygen reached 26.0 ppm after a sustained rise, indicating an atmosphere deviation despite steady temperature and argon readings.
Temperature is 750.1 °C versus 750 °C setpoint; argon is 99.9 sccm versus 100 sccm setpoint.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure readings remain unavailable, preventing verification of the required growth pressure.

args.missing_evidence: A tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; independent oxygen verification and leak/exhaust-path checks are needed to distinguish causes of the oxygen rise. No sample characterization is available.
